pix3lware is a pixel-art studio & asset shop — sprites, tilesets, animation packs and commissions for games, brands and people who miss the CRT hum.

div.h2: every good sprite starts with a bad first draft.
div.p: pix3lware started in a spare bedroom with a Game Boy, a graph-paper notebook, and way too much patience for 16×16 grids. Years later, that same patience goes into every tileset, every walk-cycle, every 4-color palette we ship.
We work the way the format demands: constraint first. No layer you don't need, no pixel you can't justify.
